title: Chișinău first mentioned
description: A charter of the Moldavian princes names the village that will become the capital.

title: Battle of Lipnic
description: Stephen the Great defeats a raiding army of the Golden Horde near the Dniester.

title: Ottomans take Bender
description: Suleiman the Magnificent annexes the fortress on the Dniester and the land around it, which stays under direct Ottoman rule.

title: Soroca Fort rebuilt in stone
description: Prince Petru Rareș replaces the wooden fort guarding a Dniester crossing with the round stone fortress that still stands.

title: Kishinev pogrom
description: Mobs kill 49 Jews over the Easter days, and the outcry abroad pushes many Jews of the Russian Empire to emigrate.

title: Moldavian Democratic Republic proclaimed
description: The Sfatul Țării, the council of Bessarabia, proclaims a republic as the Russian Empire breaks up.

title: Union of Bessarabia with Romania
description: The Sfatul Țării votes to unite Bessarabia with Romania, a union the Soviet Union never recognises.

title: Moldavian Autonomous Republic created
description: The Soviet Union sets up a Moldavian autonomous republic on the left bank of the Dniester, inside Soviet Ukraine, as a claim on Bessarabia.

title: Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic founded
description: After taking Bessarabia from Romania, the Soviet Union joins most of it to part of the autonomous republic as a new union republic.

title: Jassy–Kishinev offensive
description: The Red Army destroys the German and Romanian armies on the Dniester and retakes the republic.

title: Famine of 1946 to 1947
description: Drought and forced grain deliveries bring a famine that kills well over a hundred thousand people in the republic.

title: Operation South
description: Soviet security forces deport about 35,000 people to Siberia and Kazakhstan to break resistance to collective farms.

title: Language laws
description: The republic's parliament makes Moldovan in the Latin alphabet the state language, a turning point of the national movement.

title: Transnistria breaks away
description: Deputies from the left bank of the Dniester proclaim a separate Soviet republic, fearing union with Romania.

title: Declaration of independence
description: Parliament declares Moldova independent of the Soviet Union after the failed coup in Moscow.

title: Transnistria War
description: Fighting between Moldovan forces and separatists backed by the Russian 14th Army ends in a ceasefire that leaves Transnistria outside Moldovan control.

title: Constitution adopted
description: The constitution declares Moldova neutral and names Moldovan the state language.

title: Autonomy for Gagauzia
description: Parliament grants self-government to the Turkic-speaking Gagauz of the south, settling that conflict without war.

title: Communists return to power
description: The Communist Party wins a parliamentary majority, the first such return to power by vote in a former Soviet republic.

title: Protests of April 2009
description: Crowds disputing the Communists' election win storm the parliament and the presidency.

title: Association Agreement with the European Union
description: Moldova signs an agreement on political association and free trade with the European Union.

title: Bank fraud scandal
description: About a billion dollars, an eighth of the economy, disappears from three banks.
